name: direct left open
speaker: Cole
line: Cole at Mall court, south slip. direct left open. 2 steps. The drum stays for the start.

speaker: Ada
line: Ada: Hold the drum at Mall court. Nobody past the south slip. We start in 3 steps. Direct on the left lane, open.

name: Mall court south slip
speaker: Bess
line: Mall court south slip. Bess keeps the drum for the start. 4 steps, direct on the left lane, open.
